newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: South Korean won closes even, trapped around 829.
newsitem.headline: South Korean won closes even, trapped around 829.

text.p: The won ended flat against the dollar on Tuesday as the market traded cautiously around the 829 level, dealers said.
The won stood at 829.00 at the close after opening the same level. It ranged between 828.70 and 829.30.
"The market was directionless with most investors clinging to the sidelines," said a local dealer.

Expected month-end export negotiations and inflow of funds from depository receipt issues abroad lured buyers while the dollar's rise against the Japanese yen in the world market, coupled with import deals, brushed them away, traders said.
The won is seen moving in a range of 828.00 to 829.80 on Wednesday. The central bank set the base mid-rate at 829.00 for Wednesday against 828.50 for Tuesday.
